title: Draft: Qt: Rework Follow Stream dialog
description:
This reworks major components of the code for the follow stream dialog to ensure a faster loading of elements.

TODO:
- Move follow stuff to separate class, ensuring that the dialog only handles UI not analysis
- Replace QPlainTextEdit with QAbstractScrollArea 

Fixes:
#15211

notes.body: The first part of the change is really just cleaning up a little and removing the obvious issues with the dialog

I am currently pursuing a completely different idea for the dialogs. By implementing a FollowDataModel, we can filter and sort much easier using ProxyModels. Also, we do not need to have that many infos underneath and can separating the data gathering from display more effectively using separate threads. Display varieties may be handled by delegates and the underlying view is going to be a QListView. 

I think I’ll have a demo in a week or so to update the draft
